rv.q: For all of its humorous moments, this play ends up ripping your heart out through your eyes and ears.
This play is beautiful and devastating and moving and surprising all in 95 minutes with no intermission.

The solid performances by these ladies under the near-perfect direction of Kazemi makes for a delightful theatrical experience- one that will also have you thinking about life and perhaps your own family stories.
I found myself emotionally detaching from the never-ending conflict, holding my breath, and waiting for quietude that came far and few between.
